description: (国土交通省管轄)本明川 浸水想定区域(想定最大規模) [flood] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 長崎県. 国土交通省九州地方整備局が指定する本明川の浸水想定区域（想定最大規模）の範囲または位置などのデータをGISデータとして整備したものである。 利用規約については、国土交通省 国土数値情報HPを参照ください。 mlit. go. jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-A31-v21. htm... Coverage: 長崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 長崎県. Its tags are 河川, 災害. It offers 2 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2022-01-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
